description: We are the Women of the Current: Three Women - One Current - Infinite Possibilities
summary: We are building a "jukebox" interface which will connect visual imagery with audio generation. But not only that, we will physically portray the sound using the physical devices.
details: NASA's EIC (earth.gov) shows our changing planet as satellite maps, such as NO2, rain, storms and temperature. The Earth Jukebox lets anyone upload one of these pictures and hear a soundscape made from its data: the more pollution or intensity in the picture, the lower and darker the sound.
